text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's… new. I like it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a day out, we had planned on swinging by a particular cafe on the way home, only to find it was full. We're now at plan B.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's having a good time…)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: There's the Miraculously ☆ Milky Cafe au Lait… and the Fluffy ♪ Bunny Hop-tastic Parfait…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What a peculiar menu… I've never seen any of these at the cafes I frequent.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well, let's order… It'll be a nice surprise when we see what we get.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow her suggestion and just pick something to order.
choice_data_list: I'll have the Miraculously ☆ Milky Cafe Au Lait.
I'll have the Fluffy ♪ Bunny Hop-tastic Parfait.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I was thinking of ordering that too… It sounds the most like coffee…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We wait for our orders to arrive. And then…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It looks like a normal cafe au lait. Okay, I'm going to take a sip.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's s-so sweet!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Did they put condensed milk in this? It's a lot sweeter than I was expecting…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I think so… I just have to reach the bottom, where all the coffee is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe is struggling to drink it. Maybe she doesn't like sweet coffee? I go grab her a glass of water.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Hey, are you doing okay?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober… I didn't realize you were here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I wasn't sitting too far away so I overheard you… That drink's on the sweet side, right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, very much so… It's much sweeter than anything I usually drink.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, if you don't mind…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Would you like to switch with me? My drink has latte art on top, but it's straight black coffee underneath.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? But wait, I don't remember seeing that drink anywhere on the menu…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's in the corner, look. It's called Smiley Panda's Artsy Latte.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Smiley… Panda?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I just bought this drink on a whim! You know, just to try it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And it's pure coincidence that I'm here right now! I'm not a regular or anything!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see… I thought you might come here often, since your charming airs are such a fine fit for this cafe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Charming?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Never knew you were so good at dishing out compliments.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't say that… I just said what I was thinking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I return to my seat to find Manhattan Cafe and Mejiro Dober in cheerful conversation. It warms my heart to see such close friends chatting away.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, that does sound cute… I'll have that one as well…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We wait for our orders to arrive. And then…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This is amazing… They shaped the fluffy cream to look just like a rabbit…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: How cute…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I never would have expected us to end up in this cafe, but Manhattan Cafe does seem to be having fun. No longer concerned, I start to relax when…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hold on now! Is that the Fluffy ♪ Bunny Hop-tastic Parfait you've got there?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, Yukino… Have you come to eat one of these too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sure have. I heard they were trend'n with the city girls, so I fancied try'n one myself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …I had plans to meet a friend, but she cancel'd on account of some extra homework. So I was think'n maybe I should come anoth'r time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh… Well, why don't we share mine?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh… Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Of course… You're a fellow bunny lover, so let's make the most of this together…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, thank you kindly! Hehe, you're so nice, Cafe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The little bunny's so cute, isn't it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's… hop-tastic…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And the cream's so fluffy too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, as fluffy as a cloud…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because of their special bond as roommates, but the two of them look like they're having a wonderful time.
